title: EIN structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of Employer Identification Number candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the Swift ``detectEINs`` regex ``\d{2}-\d{7}`` and its length/shape gate.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one EIN candidate with its expected structural verdict.

ein.description: EIN candidate. Valid vectors match ``\d{2}-\d{7}``; invalid vectors deliberately deviate.

valid.description: Whether the candidate matches the Swift EIN regex shape.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this EIN, or null if valid.
